Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in its analysis of the search results. In Step 3, the Planner incorrectly stated that "Francesca Schiavone... 2011 (Wimbledon runner-up)." This is false; Francesca Schiavone was the runner-up at the **2011 French Open**, not Wimbledon. She never reached a Wimbledon singles final. The Planner likely confused the 2011 French Open final with Wimbledon due to a hallucination or misreading of the search results. Consequently, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the shared tournament was Wimbledon, when the correct answer is the French Open (where Schiavone was the 2010 winner and Morozova was the 1974 runner-up).
